name: omawall
author: Nathan Ollerenshaw (matjam)
description: Replaces the Omarchy background service with a folder-backed one: point it at a wallpaper directory and it deals every display its own random image, with optional auto-shuffle. Can also generate an Omarchy theme from the wallpaper on the primary display and switch to it, so the whole desktop tracks the picture behind it.

barWidget.description: Pick a wallpaper folder, shuffle a different random image onto each display, and optionally recolor Omarchy to match.

schema.label: Wallpaper folder
schema.description: Leave empty to use the current theme's backgrounds.

schema.label: Generate theme from wallpaper
schema.description: Build an 'omawall' Omarchy theme from the primary display's wallpaper and switch to it. Requires matugen.

schema.label: Primary display
schema.description: Output name whose wallpaper drives the theme. Empty uses the first connected display.
